questions.question: What is the best security step you can take to keep your registered email secure?

options.response: Correct! Enabling two-factor authentication on your email account wil help protect your email account from hijackers.

options.text: Have a complicated password set to my email.
options.response: Wrong! Complicated passwords are always a good idea but they are not the very best security step you can take to keep your email secure.

options.text: Use an email address just for Old School RuneScape.
options.response: Wrong! Even if you don't use your email address elsewhere there is still a risk that somebody could access it.
